raw: | Every member of an **array-rooted** import/export mapping is rejected: `"id" is not a member of the JSON structure at (Object), which has no members there` — while the identical body over an object-rooted structure works | Both executors hardcoded the root lookup to `"(Object)"`, and an array-rooted structure is built at `"(Array)"` with its item at `"(Array)|(Object)"` (`buildElementFromRawRootArray`). The root resolved to nothing, so the child lookup reported members "at (Object)" — a node that structure never had, which reads as "your key is wrong" rather than "the root was looked up in the wrong place". 122 of the 327 mapping documents in the demo apps are array-rooted, the single largest gap in the mapping surface | `mdl/executor/cmd_import_mappings.go` (`buildImportMappingElementModel`, `jsonSchemaIndex.root`), `mdl/executor/cmd_export_mappings.go` (`buildExportMappingElementModel`, `buildExportRootArrayElement`, `exportRootToPrint`) | Take the root FROM the structure instead of assuming it. No new syntax: the structure decides, and Studio Pro does not ask either. The import side then needs nothing more — the array branch was already stepping `"(Array)"` → `"(Array)|(Object)"` for NESTED arrays. **The two sides store different shapes and the difference is not guessable**: an array-rooted IMPORT mapping is ONE element at `(Array)|(Object)` (the container collapses), an array-rooted EXPORT mapping is a bare `Array` container at `(Array)` whose single child carries the entity with `ObjectHandling=Parameter`. Pin both against Studio Pro documents before writing either (`Teamcenter.IMM_ItemRevision`, `FactoryManagement.IMM_ScenarioList`, `SnowflakeIntegration.EXM_SensorData` — Evora demo app, 11.13). A second export shape exists (`DigitalTwin.EMM_EntityQuery`: entity on the container, `Find` on the item, for a parameter that OWNS the list) and MDL cannot say which is meant, so it stays unauthorable — #262. **Adding an authorable shape means teaching DESCRIBE about it in the same change**, or the newly writable mapping joins the 112 silent-loss cases of #260: the export container is not `Kind=="Object"`, so it fell into the value branch and printed `Root = ` with its whole subtree dropped. Discriminate the container on its stored **JsonPath**, not on `Kind` — the two engines' readers label it differently ("Array" vs "Object") and only the path is in the document. Controls: revert the root lookup and the repro returns verbatim, while the object-rooted control still passes; `mdl-examples/bug-tests/519-rest-mapping-as-list-of.mdl` goes from dying on its own mapping statement to executing. `mx check` needs the base project's own error count as the control (a blank app carries a pre-existing CE0495). Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-248-array-rooted-mappings.mdl`, tests `TestImportMappingArrayRoot` / `TestExportMappingArrayRoot`. Issue ako/mxcli#248 |
